hmioutline.config.title: Glint Outline
hmioutline.config.enabled.desc: Draw an outline around held items — your own in first person, and everyone's in third.
hmioutline.config.only_enchanted.desc: When on, outline only items that have an enchantment glint.
hmioutline.config.disable_glint.desc: Completely remove the vanilla enchantment glint on outlined held items, leaving only the outline.
hmioutline.config.color_default.desc: Outline color for all other materials.
hmioutline.config.thickness.desc: Outline thickness in texels of the item's own texture. The band is geometry grown in the item's own space, so its width scales with the item by itself.
hmioutline.config.third_person.desc: Also outline items held by bodies seen in third person — other players, mobs, and your own body when the camera is pulled back.
hmioutline.config.armor_enabled.desc: Draw an outline around worn armor. Armor is only ever seen in third person.
hmioutline.config.armor_only_enchanted.d: When on, outline only armor pieces that have an enchantment glint.
hmioutline.config.armor_color_diamond.de: Armor outline color for diamond armor.
hmioutline.config.armor_color_iron.desc: Armor outline color for iron armor.
hmioutline.config.armor_color_gold.desc: Armor outline color for golden armor.
Armor outline color for netherite armor.
hmioutline.config.armor_color_default.de: Armor outline color for all other materials.
hmioutline.config.armor_thickness.desc: Armor outline thickness, in texels of the armor texture.
hmioutline.config.runes.desc: Letters of the enchanting table's alphabet blinking over an enchanted item, in place of the vanilla glint's sweep. Held items and worn armor; not the trident or the shield.
hmioutline.config.rune_count.desc: How many runes an item carries. They are placed only on the item's solid pixels, and each item always wears the same pattern.
hmioutline.config.rune_density.desc: How much of the time each rune spends showing: low means the odd one flicks on and off, high means most of them are lit at once.
hmioutline.config.rune_speed.desc: How fast a rune fades in and out.
hmioutline.config.rune_scale.desc: How big a rune is drawn, like a font size. Bigger runes need more room, so a small item will hold fewer of them than the count asks for.
hmioutline.config.rune_motion.desc: What a rune does while it shows: stay put, drift upwards as it fades, or rise and sway.
hmioutline.config.armor_runes.desc: Whether worn armor gets runes too. Held items keep theirs either way.
hmioutline.config.rune_color_mode.desc: Whether every rune wears the same color or each one picks from the palette below.
hmioutline.config.rune_color.desc: The color of every rune, in one-color mode.
hmioutline.config.rune_palette.desc: The four colors runes are drawn from in palette mode. Each rune picks one afresh every time it lights up, so a color is not tied to a place on the item. Repeating a color across slots weights the mix — three whites and one gold gives the occasional gold rune.
hmioutline.config.rune_color_1.desc: One of the four colors used in palette mode.
hmioutline.config.rune_color_2.desc: One of the four colors used in palette mode.
hmioutline.config.rune_color_3.desc: One of the four colors used in palette mode.
hmioutline.config.rune_color_4.desc: One of the four colors used in palette mode.
hmioutline.config.rune_lift.desc: How far in front of the item a rune floats, in half-widths of the rune itself. Runes face the screen while the surface under them does not, so at 0 a big one is cut into by the item's own texture. 1 is enough for any size; higher lifts them clear of the item.
hmioutline.config.glow.desc: A soft halo around the enchanted item in your hand, in the item's colour, like light coming off it. Drawn behind your hand and the item, so both stay crisp in front of it. First person, held items only — worn armor never glows.
hmioutline.config.glow_match_outline.des: Take the halo's colour from the item page's per-material outline colours. Turn off to give the glow its own colours below.
hmioutline.config.glow_color_diamond.des: Halo colour for diamond items, when not using the outline colours.
hmioutline.config.glow_color_iron.desc: Halo colour for iron items, when not using the outline colours.
hmioutline.config.glow_color_gold.desc: Halo colour for golden items, when not using the outline colours.
hmioutline.config.glow_color_default.des: Halo colour for every other material, when not using the outline colours.
hmioutline.config.glow_size.desc: How far the halo spreads around the item.
hmioutline.config.glow_world_light.desc: Only with LambDynamicLights installed: whoever holds an enchanted item also lights up the blocks around them, like a held torch (light level 8). The halo is unaffected either way.
